e: Welfare Minister Reinis Uzulnieks is removed from office after being caught driving under the influence of alcohol.
A drone is shot down by a NATO fighter jet over Balvi Municipality. The incident is blamed by the Latvian Army on Russian interference.
A drone is shot down by French fighter jets belonging to a NATO contingent over Latvian airspace. The incident is blamed by the Latvian Army on Russian interference.
Andris Kulbergs is confirmed as Prime Minister by the Saeima.
Prime Minister Evika Siliņa resigns after the Progressives withdraw support from the government.
Defence Minister Andris Sprūds resigns following a demand by prime minister Siliņa following the drone incident at Rēzekne.
A drone originating from Russia crashes in Rezekne.
A suspected Ukrainian drone crashes in Krāslava.

Curlers Poļina Rožkova and Agris Lasmans become the first athletes representing Latvia to win a medal in the Paralympics after achieving bronze in the mixed doubles curling at the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy.

Latvia boycotts the opening ceremony of the 2026 Winter Paralympics in Italy in protest over Russian athletes being allowed to compete under the Russian flag after the lifting of sanctions imposed over the Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
The mayor of Ogre, Egils Helmanis, resigns citing health issues.
UEFA Futsal Euro 2026 in Latvia, Lithuania and Slovenia.
Latvia assumes a two-year non-permanent seat at the United Nations Security Council.
